hints.title: Total Ones Divisibility Rule
hints.text: The total number of set bits must be a multiple of three. If count is zero, any partition is valid.

hints.title: Starting Index of Each Part
hints.text: Let k = total // 3. Find the positions of the 1st, (k + 1)th, and (2k + 1)th set bits.

hints.title: Simultaneous Traversal Comparison
hints.text: Advance three pointers simultaneously until the third pointer reaches the end of array. If all values match, return [p1 - 1, p2].

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Finding one anchors and synchronizing pointers.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Converting large binary partitions to integers overflows 64-bit precision.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Partition based on identical count of 1s and verify matching bit patterns.
